Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game. For now, Australia has moved to the top of the table. The action of the Women’s World Cup, 2022 will continue on 14th March. There are two games coming your way. First It will be a contest between Pakistan Women and Bangladesh Women and then the big one, England will be taking on South Africa. The action begins at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous day). But as always, the build-up will begin in advance. See you then. Cheers!

Meg Lanning, the winning skipper, says they have a lot of depth in their batting and that is the beauty of the batting line up. Mentions Gardner’s innings turned the momentum and they looked to get the big wickets early on and they got it. Adds that they felt Darcie Brown with the new ball was the way to go and Megan Schutt with her cutters later on would have been more affective. Ends by saying they were looking to be aggressive with the ball earlier on.

Sophie Devine, the New Zealand Women skipper, says the way Australia came back showed the quality in their side. Adds Gardner played really well and she hit with the wind and it was going to be tough with the wind. Mentions 250-260 is par but the wicket here is good and had they kept wickets in hand, they could have chased it down. Mentions Amy Satterthwaite batted well, they could have taken time and then cashed in but could not do so. Ends by saying they now have a day off and are looking forward for the next game which is a huge game for them.

Ellyse Perry is the Player of the Match. She says it was good to re-build with Mooney and then the way Tahila and Gardner played was great. Mentions it was good to spend time in the middle, she felt it was a good wicket but the Kiwis bowled well but Tahila and Gardner finished well. States she was bowling into the breeze as she thought it would swing and Brown was really good and got important wickets. Informs she has been working on her bowling and it has come off good and all the bowlers bowled well.
Stay tuned for presentation ceremony...

It was a sorry display with the bat by the Kiwis. Yes, 270 was never going to be easy but they just surrendered. Only Amy Satterthwaite hung in there and played a good knock. Lea Tahuhu did have some fun towards the end but overall it was a disappointing display from them. They have been beaten quite comprehensively.

First they recovered from 3 down for below 60 to get to 270 and then it was their bowlers who put up a terrific display. It was Ellyse Perry who started things off by getting Sophie Devine but it was actually the Darcie Brown show. She ripped through the Kiwi batting line up taking three big wickets. The others too managed to take a wicket at least. A very clinical show with the ball.

A thumping win for Australia. The Kiwis were just no match and Australia continue to prove they are class apart. Third won for them on the trot and they have won this game by 141 runs which will do their NRR world of good for them. They regain the top spot in the points table as well.

OUT! TAKEN! Ashleigh Gardner with a sizzling knock earlier and now finishes the proceedings here. Loopy ball, on middle. Lea Tahuhu goes for the slog sweep. Connects it well but couldn't get the distance. The ball goes straight down the throat of the deep mid-wicket fielder where Beth Mooney snaffles it up. New Zealand Women are bundled out for 128. Australia Women bossed this game and they win by a huge margin of 141 runs!
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on leg, Lea Tahuhu misses her flick and gets thudded on the pads.
Drinks!
Just short! Length ball, on middle and leg. Lea Tahuhu chips it to mid on where the ball falls just short of Alana King. A single!
On a length, on middle. Lea Tahuhu tries to pull it on the leg side but fails to connect.
A yorker, on middle. Lea Tahuhu jams it out.
Length ball, outside off. Lea Tahuhu misses her cut.
DROPPED! Length ball, outside off. Jess Kerr throws the kitchen sink. She cuts it to backward point where the fielder just couldn't quite her hands on it. A single.
FOUR! Intent early on from Kerr! Short and outside off, Jess Kerr has a big heave. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
Shorter and down the leg side. This is pulled to fine leg for one.
Flatter and on off, Kerr plays it to covers.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Jess Kerr is the last batter to walk out.

OUT! TAKEN! Gardner finally gets one. Amy comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. She looks to lob it over covers but mistimes it. Meg Lanning at covers runs to her left and takes it. A good innings from Amy comes to an end. She fought a lone battle.
Commentary.Howout: c Meg Lanning b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on off, Amy pushed it to mid off.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled on the bounce to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and on middle, AS pulls but to mid-wicket.
Length and around off, Amy guides it to point.
On the stumps, Amy flicks it to mid-wicket.
Timed well but only one! Outside off, this is guided over point for one.
Outside off, this is pushed to cover for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on middle, Tahuhu looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
On off, fuller. This is hit to mid off.
On off, this one turns a touch. It is guided to point.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.

New Zealand Women have taken a review for an LBW. Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching is outside leg. The on-field decision is reversed. New Zealand Women retain their review.

NOT OUT! That has pitched outside leg. Tahuhu survives and the crowd has something to cheer about. It is on the pads. Tahuhu looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Tahuhu reviews.
Fuller and on off, this is hit through covers for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
Uses her feet again but yorks herself. She jams it out to the bowler.
LUCKY FOUR! Amy comes down the track. Wellington shortens the length. Amy swings, it goes off the outside edge past the keeper and down to the third man fence.
Tosses it up outside off, it is hit hard back to the bowler.
FOUR! Both batters have probably decided to have some fun! On middle, Amy drags it over mid-wicket and into the boundary.
Full and on off, Lea Tahuhu drives it to deep cover for a brace.

FOUR! Lucky boundary but Lea Tahuhu won't mind that. Full and on middle, Lea Tahuhu gets low and slog-sweeps it to deep square leg. She finds Alana King there who charges ahead to catch the ball. But she misjudges it completely and the ball drops short of her and spins away for a boundary.
On middle, Lea Tahuhu pokes it to cover for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up, outside off. Lea Tahuhu slices it over covers for a boundary. 100 comes up for New Zealand Women as well! Still a long way to go though.
Short of a length, outside off. Lea Tahuhu misses her cut.
Length ball, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Full and around middle and leg, raps Tahuhu on the front pad as she misses her clip. The umpire says no and the Aussies deny taking a review.

SIX! New Zealand Women have something to cheer for! Tossed up, on middle. Lea Tahuhu slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Beth Mooney there traces back and leaps but could not catch it. She was looking directly into the sun and perhaps that's why could not time her jump properly. The ball goes over her and over the ropes.
Full and around middle and leg, Tahuhu gets the outside edge once again as the ball goes to the backward point fielder.
Full and aorund off, Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to long off for one.
Not quite sure what Lea Tahuhu was doing there! Floats it up, on the pads. Amanda-Jade Wellington tries to work it on the leg side but plays too early. Gets a leading edge to square leg for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Lea Tahuhu cuts it to point.
Lea Tahuhu lifts this length ball straight down the ground and retains the strike with a single.
Length ball, on middle. Lea Tahuhu chips it to mid on but it falls well just short of the fielder.
Length ball, outside off. Lea Tahuhu looks to cut but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Megan Schutt bags her first wicket now. Hannah Rowe just gifts her wicket away. Schutt with a length ball, outside off, the ball holds up after pitching. Hannah Rowe without any feet movement chips the ball straight into the hands of Ellyse Perry at cover who takes the simplest of catches. New Zealand Women continue to struggle. Lea Tahuhu is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Ellyse Perry b Megan Schutt

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length ball, on middle. Played back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite punches it through covers for a single.
Nicely driven! Full and outside off, Hannah Rowe drives it through covers and gets a brace.
This is eased down to long off for a run.
Loopy ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite misses her sweep and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Short and outside off, Amy Satterthwaite punches it through covers off the back foot for a boundary.
On middle, clipped to square leg.
No hat-trick for Amanda-Jade Wellington! Tosses up, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite keeps it out.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! Lovely shot! Angles in a fuller ball and has been driven back past the bowler for a boundary.
On a length, outside off, the ball holds it's line and Hannah Rowe is beaten on hte poke.
Length ball, outside off. Hannah Rowe drives but finds the cover fielder.
An inswinger, on off. Rowe plays it to mid on.
Full and on off, Rowe pushes it towards covers.
Full and on middle, Amy Satterthwaite pushes it through covers for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Amanda-Jade Wellington! Loopy ball, outside off. Hayley Jensen leans, gets low and drives it uppishly towards covers. Tahlia McGrath there moves to her left and she pouches it cleanly. She ain't dropping those. New Zealand Women are showing no fight whatsoever. Amanda-Jade Wellington will be on a hat-trick in her next over. Hannah Rowe is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Amanda-Jade Wellington

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! LBW! Dead plumb and Katey Martin is already walking off! Flighted delivery, slower through the air, on middle. Katey Martin looks to work it on the leg side but gets hit right on the toe. Amanda-Jade Wellington puts up an appeal and the umpire raises the finger without any second thought. New Zealand Women sink further. Hayley Jensen walks out to bat.
Short and on off, Katey Martin keeps it out.
Loopy ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, cut away to deep cover for a single.
Full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite reaches out for it and sweeps it to square leg. The fielder there half-stops it diving to her right. A single!
Touch fuller, on off. Katey Martin pushes it to mid off. Two singles off this over as well.
Nice and straight, on middle. Katey Martin with a solid front foot defence.
Fullish, on leg. Pushed to mid on for a single.
On middle, blocked out.

Good-length ball, on off. Amy Satterthwaite taps it to point. Horrible mix up between the batters and Katey Martin is almost halfway down the pitch. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A direct hit and Katey Martin was a goner.
On a length, on off. Katey Martin dabs it down to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, Amy Satterthwaite nudges it on the leg side. Just the two singles off the over.
Shortish, outside off. Katey Martin guides it to deep point for a single.
Pushed wider again, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it to deep extra cover for one.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite leans and pushes it straight to cover.
Loopy ball, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite defends it out off the back foot.
On off, pushed to cover.
Short of a length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite rocks back and brings sweeper cover into play. She crosses ends.
Around off, Katey Martin guides it to deep backward point for a single.
Length, outside off. Katey Martin taps it to point.
On a length, angling in, on leg. Katey Martin misses her flick and gets struck on the pads.
WIDE! Another wayward ball, way too outside off this time. Katey Martin lets it go. Wided.
On the pads, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to cover.
WIDE! Great take from Alyssa Healy! Full and down the leg side, Amy Satterthwaite leaves it alone. Alyssa Healy is standing close to the stumps and does well to collect it.
This is nudged to mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Katey Martin gets low and smashes it just wide of the short cover fielder for a single.
Given loop, on off. Amy Satterthwaite kneels and sweeps it hard tp deep mid-wicket only for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite keeps it out.
Flighted delivery, on off, turning away. Katey Martin looks to defend, gets an outside edge and the ball rolls past the slip fielder for a single.
Flighted delivery to begin with, on off. Katey Martin smashes it right back at the bowler.
Outside off, this is played down to third man for one. A really good over for the Kiwis.
Fuller and on off, Martin strokes it to mid off.
FOUR! Hammered! This is a nothing delivery, short and it sits up to be hit. It is smashed through mid-wicket for a boundary. Second boundary in the over.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Hit away! Shorter and outside off, Amy Satterthwaite slaps it through covers for a boundary. 50 up for New Zealand.
Fuller and on off, Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to mid off.

Drinks! Australia Women are all over New Zealand Women right now as they have got 5 crucial wickets very early. With half the side back in the hut, the pressure is on Katey Martin and Amy Satterthwaite to repair the damage and bring some life into the game.
Shorter and on off, defended.
Two more! Fuller and on middle, Martin works it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Shorter and outside off, Martin throws her bat at it but is beaten.
Brilliant fielding! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers. Amanda-Jade Wellington hares after it from mid off and at the end, dives and pushes it back in. Saves a run for her side.
Attacks the stumps, this is played to point again.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point.
On off, Martin pushes it to mid off.
Now gets this one to come back in but the line is a little too straight. Katey Martin looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

EDGED BUT SHORT! Good fielding in the end! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Martin looks to defend, it goes off the outside edge but lands short of the widish first slip fielder. She dives and stops it.
This time she gets it past point and down to third man for one.
Length again, this too is played to point.
On off, Amy Satterthwaite guides it to point.
Another review taken by New Zealand Women for an LBW. UltraEdge shows there is indeed an inside edge. The original decision is overturned. New Zealand Women retain their review.

NOT OUT! There is a big inside edge and that is why Martin reviews. She survives to fight another day. Fuller and on off, tailing back in. Katey Martin looks to play it with a straight bat but gets an inside edge onto the pads. An appeal and the finger is raised. Martin reviews and Ultra Edge shows a spike.
Two more! Nicely played! Short and on middle, Martin pulls it through square leg for two.
Good length and on off, defended.
FORTUNATE FOUR! They are just playing Brown late. Length and on off, Martin is late in getting her bat down, it goes off the underedge, past the off pole and down to the fine leg fence.
Good length and outside off, Martin guides it to point. She wanted a run but is sent back.
Katey Martin comes in at No.7.

New Zealand Women have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows that it is pad first as there is no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching in line, the impact is in line and it is wickets hitting. The original decision stands. New Zealand Women burn their review.

OUT! THREE REDS! That was never going to be overturned! It was a review more in hope. That was dead plumb. Brown has her third and the Kiwis just can't handle the pace of the Australian pacer. This is on middle, it starts shaping away a touch. Frances Mackay plants her front foot forward and plays outside the line. She misses to get hit on the front pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. She reviews after a chat but it is a poor review. Half the side back in the hut for the hosts now.
FOUR! Creamed away! Fuller and outside off, Amy Satterthwaite leans into it and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Frances Mackay is off the mark! On the pads, she clips it down to fine leg for one.
The new batter in is Frances Mackay.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Tahlia McGrath has one now. Did brilliantly with the bat earlier on and now makes an impact straightaway with the ball. Length and around off, this one shapes away. Green looks to defend but the ball kisses the outside edge and it is taken by the keeper.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Tahlia McGrath

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Outside off, Amy Satterthwaite lets it be.
End of Powerplay 1! 4 fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Two to end! Another good over for the Aussies! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for two.
Good length and on off, defended.
Shorter and outside off, Green slashes but misses.
Another short one outside off, Green ducks under it.
That was timed well but it goes to hand! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled but to mid-wicket. There was just the one fielder in the ring on the leg side and Green found her to perfection.
Good length and on off, Green defends.
Shorter and on middle, Amy Satterthwaite works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is jammed out to mid on.
Green is off the mark! On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Edged and short! Good stop in the end by Meg Lanning! Fuller and outside off, Green looks to jam it out, it goes off the outside edge. ML dives to her left and stops it at widish first slip.
Overthrow! Outside off, this is pushed to cover. The fielder has a needless shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single as the fielder backing up does not stop it cleanly.
Fuller and on middle, this is driven back to the bowler.
A dot to end another wicket taking over. On off, Green blocks.

Top edge again but lands safe again! Short again, Amy looks to pull, she too is uncomfortable with the extra pace and bounce, it goes off the top edge and lands safe in the square leg region for one. Suzie Bates might be wondering, why did her go to hand after looking at this ball.
Good length and on middle, Amy Satterthwaite blocks.
Maddy Green walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Brown has bounced Bates and Australia have got three of the dagerous top 4 of the Kiwis. They are all over the hosts at the moment. Darcie Brown is bowling a dream spell here. Given the new ball over one of the best with the new nut, Megan Schutt and she is delivering in some style. Bangs it short and on middle, Bates looks to pull, this one gets big on her, it goes off the top edge towards mid-wicket. Tahlia McGrath takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Tahlia McGrath b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Again, on a length and around off, blocked. We were surprised when she was given the ball in place of Megan Schutt but Meg Lanning knew something we did not.
Relentless stuff from Brown. Length again and on off, defended.
Another length ball, on off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it uppishly towards covers. Another superb over from Perry. Just a single off it.
On off, Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to mid off.
On a length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite steers it to point.
Slower ball, outside off, on a length. Amy Satterthwaite dabs it to the off side.
Length ball, on middle. Suzie Bates works it to mid-wicket off the back foot for a run.
Starts nice and straight, on middle. Suzie Bates plays it to mid on.
A dot to end! Wicket maiden for Brown. On off, defended.
Bangs it short now and on middle, Amy evades it.
Another one on a length and around middle, kept out.
Fuller and on middle, Amy pushes it to mid off.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Oh, my! That is yet another outstanding catch! We have had 4 in this tournament, 4 brilliant ones, two in this game and it is difficult to chose which one is the best! Beth Mooney, take a bow, that is a stunner. That had almost past her. How did she hold on? Amelia Kerr, walks back for a low score and Australia well on top now. Brown gets a wicket and she deserves it, she has been brilliant from the start. Another away swinger, this is fuller and outside off, she lures Kerr into the drive, the ball though seams away. It goes off the outside edge, it flies off the outside edge actually. Amy Satterthwaite walks out to bat.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Wonderful shape for Brown! Fuller and outside off, shaping away. Left alone.
A dot to end a successful over! Length ball, on middle and leg. Suzie Bates keeps it out.
Full again, outside off. Suzie Bates hits it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Amelia Kerr pushes it towards covers for a single.
Amelia Kerr is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Ellyse Perry gets her revenge. Bowls a length ball, angling in, on leg. Sophie Devine tries to work it on the leg side. The ball hits her pads and ricochets onto the stumps. Just the start Australia Women would have wanted. Ellyse Perry gets rid of a big fish here. New Zealand Women lose their first and it's abig one as Sophie Devine can be dangerous. She heads back shaking her head.
FOUR! Brute power! Devine gets her first boundary. Overpitched delivery, outside off. Sophie Devine smashes it to long off for a boundary.
Fuller in length, on off. Sophie Devine drives it towards covers.
Short ball, on middle. Suzie Bates rides the bounce and pulls it to deep square for another couple of runs.
Full and on off, Suzie Bates chips it off the cue end to long on for a brace.
That's a beauty! Darcie Brown is bowling very well here. Good-length ball, around off, shaping away a tad. Suzie Bates is beaten by the swing. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Bates pushes this length ball to point.
Short of a length, on off. Suzie Bates looks to steer and gets an inside edge that rolls back to the keeper.
Fuller in length, on off. Sophie Devine looks to drive. The ball goes off the inside edge to fine leg for a run.
Length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates cuts it to point.
Short of a length again, on off. Bates pulls it this time to mid on.
FOUR! Nicely played! Cracking shot! Short of a length, outside off. Suzie Bates pounces on it and cracks it through covers for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Suzie Bates steers it down to deep backward point. The third man fielder cuts it off running across. Two taken!
Full again, outside off. Suzie Bates drives it back to the bowler.
Full and on off, Suzie Bates drives it uppishly towards covers.
Bates chops this length ball to third man for a single.
Wonderful bowling from Darcie Brown! Good-length ball, outside off, moving away. Suzie Bates is drawn foward and looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a good length, on off. Suzie Bates tries to cut it but plays it too close from the body. Gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Oh! That's lovely! Full and shaping away late from off. Suzie Bates gets beaten all ends up as she looks to drive.
Sophie Devine gets off the mark! Full and on middle, Sophie Devine pushes it to the off side for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates dabs it down to third man for a single.
Darcie Brown to operate from the other end.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Sophie Devine looks to drive but gets beaten. Good start from Ellyse Perry. 4 runs off it.
Gets it through this time! Length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates leans and drives it through covers. The outfield is a bit slow and the batters run three.
Length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates taps it towards covers.
WIDE! New Zealand Women get underway with this! Full and way too outside off. Suzie Bates goes chasing for it but misses. Wided.
Good-length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates sees the width and slashes it hard but straight to the cover fielder.
Length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates watches it closely and lets it sail through.
Perry starts with a low full toss, on off. Suzie Bates works it to mid on off the inner half of the bat.
